name: 4G mobile broadband
how: Mobile phone network, microchips; ★ OFDM (splitting a signal across many narrow subcarriers) and MIMO multi-antenna radio
impact: Carries the internet to over five billion phones, making video, maps and apps work anywhere.
why: A new generation of the Mobile phone card's network, but it changed how it works (all-internet, OFDM) and made the phone the world's main computer.

name: Solar farm
how: Photovoltaic cells, inverters, HVDC/AC grid, sun-tracking mounts; photovoltaic effect
impact: Became the cheapest electricity in history and the largest source of new power capacity worldwide.
why: Scaled-up Photovoltaic cells (1954), but the 90% price fall in the 2010s turned a satellite part into the world's main new power source.

name: End-to-end encrypted messaging
how: Smartphone, internet, public-key encryption; ★ double-ratchet key exchange (fresh keys for every message)
impact: Over two billion people's daily messages became unreadable to anyone but sender and receiver.

name: Cancer immunotherapy
how: Monoclonal antibodies; ★ immune checkpoint blockade (releasing the brakes on T cells)
impact: Turned some deadly cancers like melanoma into long-term survivable ones; now standard for many tumour types.

name: Ride-hailing apps
how: Smartphone, GPS, mobile payments, cloud data centres; real-time matching
impact: Billions of trips a year; reshaped taxis and urban transport in hundreds of cities.

name: Hepatitis C cure
how: Synthetic drugs; ★ direct-acting antivirals blocking the virus's own polymerase
impact: A 12-week pill course cures over 95% of a chronic infection carried by some 58 million people.

name: Facial recognition
how: Deep learning, CCD/CMOS cameras, infrared dot projector; ★ face embedding (matching faces as points in learned space)
impact: Unlocks over a billion phones and runs mass surveillance and border checks across much of the world.

name: Short-video feed apps
how: Smartphone, streaming video, deep learning; ★ engagement-trained recommendation feed
impact: Over two billion users scrolling an algorithm-chosen feed; reshaped media, music and politics.
why: A version of Social media, but the feed chosen by a learning algorithm rather than friends changed how it works.

name: Tablet computer
how: Capacitive touchscreen, microchips, lithium-ion battery, LCD
impact: Over a billion in use; became the computer for young children, the elderly, shops and cockpits.
why: A scaled-up Smartphone; it widened who uses computers (toddlers, elders, point-of-sale) but does the same job the same way.

name: Neural machine translation
how: Deep learning, cloud data centres; ★ sequence-to-sequence neural networks with attention
impact: Used by over a billion people a month to read and talk across languages.

name: 3D transistor (FinFET)
how: Transistor, microchips, photolithography; ★ gate wrapped around a vertical silicon fin
impact: Every phone and computer chip since about 2014 is built from these.
why: A reshaped Transistor rather than a new device, but it's how every modern chip works; same people, new how.

name: QR-code payments
how: Smartphone camera, QR code, mobile payments, real-time bank transfers
impact: Over a billion people in China and India pay this way, down to street vendors.
why: A version of Mobile payments (2007); scanning a printed code let any stall take payments, changing who could use it.

name: Grid battery storage
how: Lithium-ion battery, inverters, power grid; fast frequency response
impact: Lets grids store solar for the evening; hundreds of gigawatt-hours installed worldwide.
why: Scaled-up Lithium-ion batteries, but used in a new way: as a power plant that can switch in milliseconds.

name: OLED display
how: Thin-film transistors, organic semiconductors; ★ organic electroluminescence (each pixel makes its own light)
impact: The screen in most smartphones, billions of units.

name: Direct oral anticoagulants
how: Synthetic drugs; ★ direct inhibition of clotting factors Xa or thrombin
impact: Replaced warfarin for tens of millions at risk of stroke and clots, with no blood monitoring needed.

name: Smartwatch and fitness tracker
how: Microchips, MEMS accelerometer, optical heart-rate sensor (photoplethysmography), short-range wireless link, lithium-ion battery
impact: Worn by hundreds of millions to count steps, heartbeats and sleep, and to catch irregular heart rhythms.

name: SGLT2 inhibitors
how: Synthetic drugs; ★ blocking glucose re-uptake in the kidney so sugar leaves in urine
impact: Standard treatment for diabetes, heart failure and kidney disease in tens of millions.

name: Biometric digital ID
how: Fingerprints, iris scanners, cloud data centres, mobile phone
impact: Gave 1.3 billion Indians an ID used for welfare, banking and phone SIMs; copied across Africa and Asia.

name: E-cigarette
how: Lithium-ion battery, heating coil, nicotine liquid; Joule heating, aerosol
impact: Used by over 80 million people; displaced cigarettes for many and hooked teens.
why: First sold in China in 2004, so the date is a stretch; mass use came in the 2010s (pod vapes 2015).

name: Phone fingerprint sensor
how: Fingerprints, capacitive sensor array, secure chip
impact: Unlocks and pays on billions of phones.
why: Fingerprints (1885) put somewhere new; a fresh sensor made biometrics an everyday thing for everyone.

name: Food delivery apps
how: Smartphone, GPS, mobile payments, courier fleets; real-time dispatch
impact: Hundreds of millions order meals this way; reshaped restaurants, especially in China.
why: Is it an invention or a business? It's ride-hailing's dispatch applied to meals.

name: Swipe dating apps
how: Smartphone, GPS, social media; mutual-match swiping
impact: By the late 2010s the most common way couples meet in the US and much of Europe.
why: A version of online dating (1995); location and swiping changed who used it, but the job is the same.

name: EUV lithography
how: Photolithography, CO2 laser, multilayer mirrors, vacuum; ★ laser-produced tin plasma emitting 13.5 nm light
impact: Every leading-edge chip (phones, AI accelerators) is now printed with it.
why: Recent and invisible to users, but the entire leading-edge chip industry now runs on one firm's machine.

name: Prenatal DNA blood test
how: DNA sequencing, blood draw; ★ fetal DNA fragments circulating in the mother's blood
impact: Screens tens of millions of pregnancies for Down syndrome without amniocentesis.

name: Software containers
how: Cloud data centres, operating system isolation (namespaces, cgroups)
impact: The standard way most of the world's online services are packaged and run.

name: Wireless earbuds
how: Short-range wireless link, MEMS microphones, lithium-ion battery, loudspeaker
impact: Hundreds of millions sold a year; changed how people listen and take calls.
why: Short-range wireless link plus Portable music player, shrunk; same job, mostly the same people.

name: Stroke clot retrieval
how: Catheter, stent, X-ray imaging; ★ mechanical thrombectomy (pulling the clot out with a stent-mesh)
impact: Became standard care for major strokes, sharply cutting disability.

name: Cyberweapons
how: Computers, internet, software exploits
impact: Since Stuxnet wrecked Iranian centrifuges, a standard tool of state conflict against grids, pipelines and hospitals.

name: Ransomware
how: Public-key encryption, internet, cryptocurrency payments
impact: Hits hospitals, cities and pipelines; a multi-billion-dollar criminal industry.
why: Is malware an assembly? It's a method, like email, but a criminal one.

name: Transcatheter heart valve
how: Catheter, stent, animal-tissue valve, X-ray imaging
impact: Replaced open-heart surgery for most aortic valve patients; hundreds of thousands a year.
why: First approved in Europe in 2007; US approval (2011) made it widely used, so the date is debatable.

name: Wireless phone charging
how: Electromagnetic induction, coils, lithium-ion battery; ★ resonant inductive coupling
impact: Built into most mid- and high-end phones, watches and earbuds.
why: Inductive charging was in electric toothbrushes from the 1990s; phones put it in everyone's hands.

name: Cartridge PCR test
how: PCR (DNA copying), microfluidic cartridge, fluorescence detection
impact: The standard tuberculosis test in poor countries; tens of millions of tests a year, later used for COVID.
why: PCR in a sealed cartridge; same method, but it moved molecular testing from labs to rural clinics.

name: Air fryer
how: Electric heating element, fan; forced convection, Maillard browning
impact: In over half of UK and US homes within a decade.
why: A small convection oven; everyday in many homes, but is it more than a kitchen convenience?

name: Emoji
how: Unicode text encoding, smartphone keyboards, colour fonts
impact: Billions of people use them daily in messages.
why: Invented in Japan in 1999; became global when added to Unicode (2010). Is a writing addition an assembly?

name: Dockless bike and e-scooter sharing
how: Bicycle, electric motor, lithium-ion battery, GPS, smartphone app with QR unlock
impact: Hundreds of millions of riders, mostly in Chinese cities.
why: Is it an invention or a business? Docked bike-share is older; GPS and phone unlock made it dockless.

name: AI accelerator chip
how: Microchips, high-bandwidth memory; ★ systolic arrays for matrix multiplication
impact: Trains and runs all modern AI, from translation to large language models.
why: A specialised Microchip for Deep learning; the field now runs on it, but it does the same job faster.

name: Crop-spraying drone
how: Quadcopter drone, GPS, pumps and nozzles
impact: Spray hundreds of millions of acres a year in China and Asia, replacing backpack sprayers.
why: Quadcopter drone put on farms; it changed who sprays and how, but is still the same flying machine.

name: Pay-as-you-go solar kit
how: Photovoltaic cells, LED lighting, lithium battery, mobile payments; remote lock-out
impact: Brought first electric light to tens of millions of off-grid people in Africa and Asia.
why: Big for its users, but tens rather than hundreds of millions.

name: Rocket interceptor system
how: Radar, guided missiles, computers; trajectory prediction to engage only threats
impact: Intercepted thousands of rockets over Israel; now copied and sought by many countries.
why: Missile defence is older (Patriot, 1980s); this made it cheap and fast enough for short-range rockets.

name: Phone-based two-factor login
how: Smartphone, public-key encryption; ★ time-based one-time codes from a shared secret
impact: Protects billions of email, bank and work accounts.
why: Hardware code tokens existed since the 1980s; phones made it everyone's practice.

name: Team chat apps
how: Internet, cloud data centres, smartphone
impact: Hundreds of millions of office workers coordinate by channels rather than email.
why: Messaging applied to offices: the same job as Email, done the same way.

name: CAR-T cell therapy
how: Genetic engineering, virus vectors, T cells; ★ chimeric antigen receptor
impact: Cures some blood cancers that nothing else could; tens of thousands treated so far.
why: A new kind of medicine, but still only tens of thousands treated.

name: Smart speaker
how: Voice assistants, MEMS microphone array, loudspeaker, Wi-Fi
impact: In hundreds of millions of homes.
why: Voice assistants (2011) put in a speaker: same job, same way.

name: Airport body scanner
how: Millimetre-wave radio, antennas, computers; ★ millimetre-wave imaging through clothing
impact: Screens billions of air passengers.
why: Near the decade's cut: billions pass through one, but it's a checkpoint gadget.

name: Meningitis A conjugate vaccine
how: Conjugate vaccine, cold chain
impact: Given to over 300 million people across Africa's meningitis belt, nearly ending epidemics there.
why: Near the decade's cut: huge for Africa, but one more vaccine on an old method.

name: Low-warming refrigerant
how: Air conditioning, refrigerators; fluorinated olefins that break down in days
impact: Now in most new car air conditioners in Europe and the US.
why: Near the decade's cut: a substitute chemical in an existing machine.

name: Livestream shopping
how: Streaming video, smartphone, mobile payments
impact: Hundreds of billions of dollars of sales a year in China.
why: Near the decade's cut, and more a business than an invention.

name: Language-learning apps
how: Smartphone, cloud data centres, spaced repetition
impact: Over 100 million learners a month.
why: Near the decade's cut: popular, but still a niche use of the phone.

name: Automated insulin delivery
how: Continuous glucose monitor, insulin pump, control algorithm
impact: Lets many type 1 diabetics run their blood sugar on autopilot.
why: Continuous glucose monitor / insulin pump (1999) joined by an algorithm; changed how it works, so borderline not drop.

name: Gene therapy
how: Genetic engineering, harmless virus vectors (AAV)
impact: Cures a few rare inherited diseases; thousands treated.
why: Real but tiny scale so far.

name: Computational phone photography
how: Smartphone, CCD/CMOS sensors, deep learning; burst stacking
impact: Most of the world's photos are taken this way.
why: Digital camera made smarter: same job, same way, same people.

name: Loitering munition
how: Military drones, explosive warhead, camera
impact: Widely used in the Nagorno-Karabakh and Ukraine wars.
why: A version of Military drones; mass use came after 2020.

name: Daily satellite imaging of Earth
how: Small satellites, CCD image sensor, launch rideshares
impact: Images all the Earth's land every day for farmers, insurers and militaries.
why: Near the decade's cut: mostly used by specialists, not in daily life.

name: 5G mobile broadband
how: 4G mobile broadband, ★ millimetre-wave and massive-MIMO beamforming
impact: Over two billion subscriptions by 2025.
why: The next generation of 4G: same job, same way, same people.

name: Power bank
how: Lithium-ion battery, USB charging circuit
impact: Carried by hundreds of millions.
why: Lithium-ion battery in a box: same job.

name: Electric multicooker
how: Pressure cooker, microcontroller, electric heater
impact: Tens of millions of kitchens.
why: Below the decade's cut; a pressure cooker with a timer.

name: Video doorbell
how: Camera, Wi-Fi, smartphone, cloud
impact: Tens of millions of homes.
why: Below the decade's cut.

name: VR headset
how: OLED display, lenses, gyroscopes, accelerometers
impact: Tens of millions sold, mostly for games.
why: Below the decade's cut; still not in most people's lives.

name: Phone tap-to-pay wallet
how: Contactless card, smartphone, secure chip
impact: Hundreds of millions pay with phones and watches.
why: Contactless card (1995) moved into the phone: same job, same way.

name: 3D NAND flash
how: Flash memory, microchips; memory cells stacked in vertical layers
impact: All modern phone and SSD storage.
why: Flash memory stacked up: same job, same way, same people.

name: Electric bus
how: Electric car drivetrain, lithium-ion battery, bus
impact: Over half a million in Chinese cities.
why: Electric car scaled up: same job, same way.

name: Geared turbofan
how: Turbofan jet engine, gearbox
impact: On thousands of new airliners.
why: Turbofan jet engine refined: same job, same way.

name: Home battery
how: Lithium-ion battery, inverter
impact: Millions of homes with rooftop solar.
why: Lithium-ion battery on a garage wall.

name: Universal reversible connector
how: Insulated wire & cable, microchips
impact: On billions of phones and laptops; mandated in the EU.
why: Below the decade's cut; a plug.

name: HIV prevention pill
how: Antiretroviral HIV therapy given before exposure
impact: Millions take it; cut new infections in gay men sharply.
why: Like the stomach-ulcer cure: old antiretrovirals aimed at a new use, no new assembly.

name: Plant-based burger
how: Plant proteins, heme from engineered yeast
impact: Sold widely but a few percent of meat sales.
why: Not in most people's daily lives.

name: Cryo-electron microscopy
how: Electron microscope, direct electron detector, image averaging
impact: Solves protein structures for drug design.
why: A research instrument.

name: Nanopore sequencer
how: DNA sequencing, protein nanopore; ★ ionic current blockade by passing DNA
impact: Pocket-sized sequencing in labs and outbreaks.
why: A research instrument.

name: Malaria vaccine
how: Recombinant protein vaccine, adjuvant
impact: Pilot rollout in three African countries.
why: Still pilots in 2019; wide use only from 2023.

name: Perovskite solar cell
how: Photovoltaic cells, perovskite crystals
impact: Record efficiencies in labs.
why: Still in labs and pilot lines.

name: Wolbachia mosquitoes
how: Bacteria, mosquito breeding; ★ Wolbachia blocking dengue virus
impact: Released over several million people's cities.
why: Mostly trials and city pilots.

name: Foldable phone
how: Smartphone, flexible OLED display
impact: A few percent of phone sales.
why: A Smartphone that folds: same job, same people.

name: Hypersonic glide missile
how: Intercontinental ballistic missile, glide vehicle
impact: A handful deployed by Russia and China.
why: Barely deployed; mostly tests.
